name: paste-centre-doodads
description: bugs.md 'A pasted pathless doodad (LPcr) lands on the 64 grid in Studio but at the pointer in the World Editor' and engineering.md's spec job for pasteCentreAt's rule. Input tests/fixtures/we-compare/make-paste-centre-input.mjs (camera 0, 200 from 4000, the first of the camera palette). A click on bare ground (300,760) after the camera; doodad layer: per paste the pointer to a box's corner (the upper left for doodads, the lower left for units: away from the models, which stand up from their feet; a drag that starts on a model selects nothing), 400 ms, the box (--drag over 1200 ms: a quicker one on this slow display has dragged the doodad under the pointer instead) round the object(s), Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, the pointer to an off-grid spot of the row y 390, a click, Escape twice; before each but the first a probe: the lone LPcr (-901.3, 1013.7) pasted at the same pixel, which lands at the pointer. Pasted: LPcr, a barrel LTbs (2x2), a tree LTlt (4x4), LOsh (2x2), LTbs + LPcr, two LPcr, LOsh + LTlt, LTbs + LTlt. Studio: the same boxes and clicks (we-compare-ui drag/click), w3.terrain.copy / paste. MATCH (2026-11-15, branch paste-centre-we; tolerance 8: the pointers of the two views): pathless alone (one or two LPcr) at the pointer, the rest by whole 64s (placement.ts copyCentre, pasteCentreAt)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !(s.placedObjects()?.units?.length && s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-tab')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Select').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.copy'); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.paste'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));
